verse_text_english: In the name of God,
A questioner may question the inevit­ able retribution.
For the disbelievers, none can stop it.
From GOD; Possessor of the highest Height.
The angels, with their reports, climb to Him in a day that equals Fifty thousand years.
verse_text_arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
verse_text_transliterated: taʿruju l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu khamsīna alfa sanati
verse_text_arabic_clean: تعرج الملئكة والروح إليه فى يوم كان مقداره خمسين ألف سنة

verse_text_english: Therefore, you shall resort to a gracious patience.
For they see it far away.
While we see it very close.
The day will come when the sky will be like molten rocks.
The mountains will be like fluffy wool.
No friend will care about his close friend. 1 2645 r 569
When they see them, the guilty will wish he could give his own children as ransom, to spare him the retribution of that day.
verse_text_arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-muj'rimu law yaftadī min ʿadhābi yawmi-idhin bibanīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: يبصرونهم يود المجرم لو يفتدى من عذاب يومئذ ببنيه

verse_text_english: Also his spouse, and his brother.
Even his whole tribe that raised him.
Even all the people on earth, if it would save him.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
verse_text_transliterated: waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīh
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن فى الأرض جميعا ثم ينجيه

verse_text_english: No; it is aflame.
Eager to burn.
It calls on those who turned away.
Those who hoarded and counted.
Indeed, the human being is anxious.
If touched by adversity, despondent.
If blessed by wealth, stingy.
Except for the worshipers.
Who always observe their contact prayers (Salat).
Part of their money is set aside.
For the poor and the needy.
They believe in the Day of Judgment
They reverence their Lord’s requital.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum min ʿadhābi rabbihim mush'fiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذين هم من عذاب ربهم مشفقون

verse_text_english: Their Lord’s requital is not taken for granted.
They keep their chastity.
(They have relations) only with their spouses, or what is legally theirs—
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا على أزوجهم أو ما ملكت أيمنهم فإنهم غير ملومين

verse_text_english: anyone who transgresses these limits is a sinner—
verse_text_arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمن ابتغى وراء ذلك فأولئك هم العادون

verse_text_english: And the believers keep their word; they are trustworthy.
Their testimony is truthful.
They consistently observe their contact prayers (Salat), on time.
They have deserved a position of honor, in Paradise.
What is keeping those who disbelieved from joining you?
To the right, and to the left, they flee.
How can any of them expect to enter the blissful Paradise?
verse_text_arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: ayaṭmaʿu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yud'khala jannata naʿīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: أيطمع كل امرئ منهم أن يدخل جنة نعيم

verse_text_english: Never; we created them, and they know from what. 0 2645 570
I solemnly swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests; we are able—
verse_text_arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: falā uq'simu birabbi l-mashāriqi wal-maghāribi innā laqādirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلا أقسم برب المشرق والمغرب إنا لقدرون

verse_text_english: to substitute better people in your place; we can never be defeated.
verse_text_arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: aala an nubaddila khayran minhum wamanahnu bimasbooqeena
verse_text_arabic_clean: على أن نبدل خيرا منهم وما نحن بمسبوقين

verse_text_english: Therefore, let them blunder and play, until they meet the day that is awaiting them.
verse_text_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتى يلقوا يومهم الذى يوعدون

verse_text_english: That is the day they come out of the graves in a hurry, as if herded to the (sacrificial) altars.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi sirāʿan ka-annahum ilā nuṣubin yūfiḍūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يخرجون من الأجداث سراعا كأنهم إلى نصب يوفضون

verse_text_english: With their eyes subdued, shame will cover them. That is the dav that is awaiting them. ( \
verse_text_arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhālika l-yawmu alladhī kānū yūʿadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: خشعة أبصرهم ترهقهم ذلة ذلك اليوم الذى كانوا يوعدون
